name: Maplewood Events
description: A decorated indoor event venue in Spanish Fork with reclaimed wood tables, included decor chosen at a design consultation, a dance floor with lighting and sound, two private dressing rooms, a warming kitchen and an open-vendor policy; alcohol is not allowed.

Features > Indoors.wording: Large open room with wood tables and chairs

Features > Sparklers allowed.wording: Sparkler package with lighting and disposal: 50 for $65, 100 for $100

Decor > Ceremony arch / backdrop.wording: Backdrop with choice of included decor

Decor > Draping / chair covers.wording: Ceiling Drapes White organza draped ceiling. $350

Decor > Signs / easels.wording: Picture frames, easels, chalkboards and signs

Decor > Chandeliers.wording: Chandeliers shown in the venue's photo gallery

items.label: Description
items.value: A decorated indoor event venue in Spanish Fork with reclaimed wood tables, included decor chosen at a design consultation, a dance floor with lighting and sound, two private dressing rooms, a warming kitchen and an open-vendor policy; alcohol is not allowed.

items.label: Packages & add-ons
items.value:
Additional 1-hour block — $200
Ceremony within booked time (up to 100 white chairs, decorated backdrop) — $100 if renter takes down chairs; $200 if Maplewood does
Ceremony with a 1-hour block added — $300-$400
Rental includes 10 reclaimed wood tables, 80-100 wood chairs, 4 bar tables with 3 stools each, backdrop, sign-in tables, gift area, cake table, serving tables, warming kitchen, 2 dressing rooms, sound system, microphone, Smart TV, dance lighting and an onsite attendant

items.value: Large open room with wood tables and chairs

items.value: 2 private dressing rooms with vanities, mirrors and seating

items.value:
Ceiling draping (white organza) — $350
Chandelier flowers (wisteria) — $200
Ceiling draping and chandelier flowers — $400
Head table with decor — $50/table

50's Chevy truck by the backdrop — $350
Soft serve ice cream machine — $155
Digital photo booth — $200

2 guest seating areas
Onsite attendant

Outside caterers allowed
Open vendor policy

items.label: Kitchen / prep
items.value:
Warming kitchen with fridge, stove, sink, microwave and counter space
No cooking allowed in the building
Plates, napkins, cups and kitchen utensils not provided

items.label: Alcohol
items.value: No alcohol inside or in the parking lot; $500 fine and event closure

items.label: Sparklers allowed
items.value: Sparkler package with lighting and disposal: 50 for $65, 100 for $100

items.label: Sparklers
items.value: Sparkler package (lighting and disposal) — $65 for 50, $100 for 100

items.label: Restrictions
items.value:
No alcohol
No confetti or glitter inside or in the parking lot (automatic fine)
No fog machines or spark-free pyrotechnics
No tape, command strips or nails on walls
Fake petals only for ceremony aisle
No propane grills or fryers
Building access only during booked time
Events end by 10pm

items.label: Notes
items.value:
Building occupancy 224
Reception seating: 112 included, up to 162 with added tables at extra cost
Weekend rates apply Thursday-Sunday
